caption:
IT and technology services businesses often work on a project or retainer basis, with income that can be lumpy relative to steady staff and overhead costs. A flexible line of credit can smooth cash flow between project milestones or client payment cycles.

Every industry has its own rhythm when it comes to cash flow and finance needs — understanding it and technology services's specific pattern is the first step to finding the right fit.

Project-based billing means IT and technology businesses often need finance that flexes with milestone timing.
